deadline.value: December 15, 2026, 11:59 pm Eastern (GSAS lists Physics under Dec 15, 2026)
deadline.quote: The General GRE and Physics GRE scores are Optional for applications received by the December 15, 2026, submission deadline.

also.quote: All application deadlines are as of 11:59 pm Eastern time.

app_fee.value: USD 105 for all degree-seeking applicants, non-refundable
app_fee.quote: The application fee for all degree-seeking applicants is US $105.00.

fee_waiver.value: Non-US citizens are eligible to request; granted for listed special programs or documented financial hardship. Request separately, well before the Dec 15 deadline (form closes Jan 2).
fee_waiver.quote: US citizens, permanent residents, and non-US citizens are all eligible to request a fee waiver. | Fee waivers may be granted on the basis of: | documented financial hardship | The final deadline to submit a fee waiver request is January 2.

gre_general.value: General GRE optional; no preference either way in holistic review
gre_general.quote: The General GRE and Physics GRE scores are Optional for applications received by the December 15, 2026, submission deadline. All applications are reviewed holistically, and preference will not be given to students who do or do not submit GRE scores.

gre_physics.value: Physics GRE optional; no preference either way in holistic review
gre_physics.quote: The General GRE and Physics GRE scores are Optional for applications received by the December 15, 2026, submission deadline. All applications are reviewed holistically, and preference will not be given to students who do or do not submit GRE scores.

toefl_min.value: No minimum score for the Physics PhD; TOEFL Speaking 25 or below (IELTS Speaking 7.5 or below) means a required summer English program before matriculation
toefl_min.quote: There is no minimum language requirement for the Physics PhD program. | The Graduate School does require incoming doctoral students who received a score of 25 or below on the TOEFL Speaking section or a 7.5 or below on IELTS Speaking section to participate in a Summer English Language program at Yale in August prior to matriculation.

english_waiver.value: Exempt with a bachelor's from an institution where English is the primary language of instruction AND at least three years in residence there; answered in the application, no separate documents; a master's or PhD does not count
english_waiver.quote: If you have received (or will receive) an undergraduate degree from a college or university where English is the primary language of instruction, and if you have studied in residence at that institution for at least three years, you are exempt from the English Language Test requirement and are not required to submit the TOEFL or IELTS. | No exemptions are made on the basis of an advanced degree (e.g., MA/MS or PhD) from any institution.

funding.value: Every PhD student gets full tuition plus a stipend for at least five years; department FAQ says all admitted students receive financial aid
funding.quote: Every PhD student receives a funding package that covers the full cost of tuition and provides a stipend to cover basic living costs like rent, food, and books — for a minimum of five years.

also.quote: Do all admitted students receive financial aid? | A University stipend, Teaching Fellowship and full tuition are provided by Yale (typically for the first 3 or 4 semesters).

entry_route.value: A master's is not required to apply for a Yale PhD (some programs prefer post-baccalaureate training)
entry_route.quote: A Master's degree is not required to apply for a PhD at Yale, although some programs give preference to applicants with post-baccalaureate training.

notes: Applied Physics and Astronomy are separate Yale programs (also Dec 15). The department apply page still shows an old 'deadline has passed' banner above the current Dec 15, 2026 text.
